policy.decision: Apply only the two explicit human-reviewed representative-domain assignments created with the 2026-09-11 Talleyrand/Bernadotte registration; do not infer domains from Role and do not modify any existing Person-domain assignment.

review_scope.rationale: Talleyrand's historical representative identity is statecraft and high political-diplomatic power; Bernadotte's representative identity culminates in crown-prince leadership, kingship, and dynastic state leadership. Both therefore map to ATLAS governance rather than military despite Bernadotte's earlier marshal career.
